latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release with cloud-based AI video editing.

- Edit raw video footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) into polished 1080p MP4s using cloud AI.
- Simple onboarding: supports anonymous sessions with auto token handling (100 free credits, 7-day expiry).
- Upload, cut pauses, add transitions, overlay text/audio, and export videos — all driven by natural language prompts.
- Fast rendering: most videos processed within 1–2 minutes on cloud GPUs.
- Clear error codes, step-by-step status updates, and easy session management.
- Export and download edited videos in widely compatible formats.
